purpose: Preserve Koios.News's already-public predecessor record during a controlled delivery migration without representing legacy manuscripts as newly accepted under the current newsroom gate.
admission: An article may enter either controlled-migration publication profile under exact-editorial-acceptance when its current manuscript digest has a deterministic standards pass and an independent accepting editorial judgment.
An article lacking exact-editorial-acceptance may enter only when the predecessor Koios publication store marks it public and the current live Koios feed witnesses the same canonical route.
A predecessor-publication witness preserves availability and correction obligations; it does not assert that the manuscript passes current standards.
publicEvidence: /publication-provenance.json names the authority, current manuscript digest, deterministic gate state, and exact editorial-acceptance state for every carried article.
/newswire-audit.json remains the public current-gate reading and is never rewritten to make a legacy article appear compliant.
Each predecessor-witness article page carries a visible public-record notice.
invariants: Every new newsroom publication still requires exact-manuscript independent editorial acceptance.
No migration act mutates the separately owned content store.
No live canonical route may disappear at cutover.
A route absent from the frozen predecessor witness is admissible to either profile only when exact-editorial-acceptance authorizes it.

The shadow and cutover candidate must be projected by the same renderer from the same public-record witness; their only permissible byte differences are the declared indexing advertising privacy and security-policy consequences of the selected profile.
Corrections and retractions apply equally to predecessor-witness and exact-accepted articles.
Cutover remains forbidden without a provider-authored bilateral EVM effect cell, preview witness, route preservation, rollback rehearsal, and an explicit priced authority-transfer seam.
